reviews.comment:
La atención de las chicas del full es pésima. Los baños estaban sucios, eran baños quimicos. no tenían agua caliente para el mate, 2 maquinas rotas. Un desastre porque si te hablan amablemente uno entiende y sabe disculpar, pero encima de malagana y mal hablados. La próxima hago unos kilómetros más, ahí no paro más.

(Translated by Google)
The service from the girls at the Full was terrible. The bathrooms were filthy, they were portable toilets. There was no hot water for mate, and two of the machines were broken. It was a disaster because if they speak to you politely, you understand and can forgive, but on top of that, they were rude and swear. Next time I'll drive a few more kilometers; I won't stop there again.
